Fettuccini Alfredo Sauce
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 11:45pm

Ingredients




3 tablespoons Butter
1 1/2 cups Fresh cream
1/2 cup Grated parmesan cheese, (Italian)
1/2 teaspoon Mustard
Salt and freshly ground white pepper
A tiny pinch of nutmeg.

Preparation

1 1. Melt butter in a pan. 2 2. Add rest of ingredients, except cheese. 3 3. Reduce sauce until it begins to thicken 4 4. Stir in cheese off the heat. 5 NOTES : You may add any of the following: smoked salmon. prosciutto, mushrooms cooked in butter
